title: Publication Policies
author: Dweep Tulika
html:
About Dweep Tulika

Dweep Tulika is an independent online news and information publication covering local, regional, national, and international news, with special focus on the Andaman & Nicobar Islands. Our aim is to provide accurate, timely, and reliable information to our readers.

Editorial Standards

We strive to ensure that all published content is factual, accurate, and sourced from reliable information. News articles are prepared based on official press releases, government notifications, verified sources, interviews, and on-ground reporting whenever available.

Corrections Policy

If any factual error is identified in a published article, Dweep Tulika will review the matter and make necessary corrections promptly. Readers may contact us regarding any inaccuracies.

Sources and Attribution

Information obtained from government agencies, public institutions, press releases, and other authorized sources is properly attributed whenever applicable.

Opinion Content

Opinion articles, editorials, and guest contributions represent the views of their respective authors and do not necessarily reflect the views of Dweep Tulika.

Independence and Integrity

Editorial decisions are made independently. We are committed to maintaining fairness, accuracy, and transparency in our reporting.

User Feedback

Readers may contact us with suggestions, corrections, or feedback through the contact details provided on this website.

Contact Information

For editorial inquiries, corrections, or feedback, please contact:

Dweep Tulika
Email: dweeptulika@gmail.com
Location: Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, India

title: Privacy Policy
author: Dweep Tulika
html:
Last Updated: June 2026

Welcome to Dweep Tulika. We value the privacy of our visitors and are committed to protecting any personal information collected through this website.

Information We Collect

Dweep Tulika may collect limited information such as:

  • Name and email address when voluntarily submitted through contact forms or comments.
  • Non-personal information including browser type, device information, IP address, and pages visited.

How We Use Information

The information collected may be used to:

  • Improve website content and user experience.
  • Respond to inquiries and feedback.
  • Monitor website performance and traffic.

Cookies

This website may use cookies to enhance user experience and analyze website traffic. Users may choose to disable cookies through their browser settings.

Third-Party Services

Dweep Tulika may use third-party services such as Google Analytics, Google AdSense, or other services that may collect information in accordance with their own privacy policies.

External Links

Our website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of such websites.

Data Security

Reasonable measures are taken to protect user information; however, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

Children's Privacy

Dweep Tulika does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13.

Changes to This Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.

Contact Us

For questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our Contact Us page or at:

Dweep Tulika
Email: dweeptulika@gmail.com
